home.title: Give your unfinished side project a second life
home.description: Second Chance Archive connects developers who want to pass on abandoned or unfinished projects with adopters ready to continue the work — preserving ideas and saving development time.
home.startBody: Browse the catalog to see what others have published, then pick the one that fits.
home.authorsBody: Pass your project to someone who will finish it and get credit for the work you started.

authors.step1Body: Add repo, notes, goals, and a clear adoption checklist.
authors.step2Body: Choose a license and what support you can offer the adopter.
authors.step3Body: Review candidates or let the community pick the best fit.

home.adoptersBody: Find an interesting codebase and continue the work with clear handoff notes.

adopters.step1Body: Search by tech stack, completeness, or project size.
adopters.step2Body: Send a message and propose a plan to continue the project.
adopters.step3Body: Finish features, update docs, and credit the original author.

accept.line3: Once they accept, you lose ownership of the repository and its settings, and you can no longer push, merge, or delete it from your account.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: Welcome to Second Chance Archive ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your data.
privacy.s2Github: When you log in via GitHub OAuth, we collect your public GitHub profile information, including your username, avatar URL, profile link, and public email address.
privacy.s2Repo: Information about projects you list or apply to adopt, including repository URLs, names, descriptions, and metadata imported from GitHub.
privacy.s2Activity: Information regarding your project applications, messages, bookmarks, and platform interactions.
privacy.s3Intro: We use the collected data for the following purposes:
privacy.s3a: To authenticate your identity via GitHub and maintain your user session.
privacy.s3b: To connect project authors with potential adopters and facilitate project handovers.
privacy.s3c: To display your public profile, created projects, and application statuses.
privacy.s3d: To maintain platform security and prevent fraudulent listings.
privacy.s4Body: We do not sell or rent your personal data. We interact with the GitHub API to authenticate users and fetch repository data. Public information (such as your username, profile, and listed projects) is visible to other platform users to facilitate collaboration.
privacy.s5Body: We implement standard security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.
privacy.s6Body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can reach out to us on email.

terms.s3Handover: Any repository handover, transfer agreement, or license choice (e.g., MIT, Apache 2.0) executed via the platform creates a direct contractual relationship between the Author and the Adopter. Second Chance Archive is not a party to such agreements.
